newsitem.title: CHINA: Lujiazui shareholders decide no dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lujiazui shareholders decide no dividend for 1996.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development have approved the company's plan to issue no cash dividend or bonus issue for 1996, a company statement said.
They also set the company's 1997 sales target at 1.2 billion yuan and net profit target at 630 million yuan, the statement in Thursday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The company said in its annual report that it made 595.041 million yuan net profit in 1996 based on international accounting standards, up 51.41 percent from 393.003 million yuan in 1995.
